```{r baseline ptau correlation}
# ============================================================
# SA4: Baseline plasma pTau217 associations
 

# standardize names (keep originals but create clean columns)
dat <- blptau %>%
  transmute(
    subject_label = trimws(as.character(subject_label)),
    CohortAssgn   = trimws(as.character(CohortAssgn)),
    Centiloids_wcbl = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Centiloids_wcbl)),
    meta_temporal_MRIBASED_SUVR = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(meta_temporal_MRIBASED_SUVR)),
    pTau217 = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(`pTau217.Conc..pg.mL.`))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(subject_label) & subject_label != "") %>%
  filter(CohortAssgn %in% c("EOAD", "EOnonAD")) %>%
  distinct(subject_label, .keep_all = TRUE)

cat(sprintf("[SA4] Total baseline unique participants (EOAD/EOnonAD only): %d\n", nrow(dat)))
cat(sprintf("[SA4] pTau217 non-missing: %d\n", sum(!is.na(dat$pTau217))))


```
```{r ptau on eoad vs eononad}
 
roc_df <- dat %>%
  filter(!is.na(pTau217)) %>%
  mutate(
    # outcome: EOAD = 1 (positive class), EOnonAD = 0
    y = ifelse(CohortAssgn == "EOAD", 1, 0)
  )

cat(sprintf("[SA4][ROC] N participants used (non-missing pTau217): %d (EOAD=%d, EOnonAD=%d)\n",
            nrow(roc_df),
            sum(roc_df$y == 1),
            sum(roc_df$y == 0)))

# ROC object
roc_obj <- pROC::roc(
  response = roc_df$y,
  predictor = roc_df$pTau217,
  direction = ">",          # higher pTau217 predicts EOAD
  ci = TRUE,
  quiet = TRUE
)

auc_val <- as.numeric(pROC::auc(roc_obj))
auc_ci  <- as.numeric(pROC::ci.auc(roc_obj))  # 3 numbers: lower, mid, upper

# Youden index optimal threshold
youden <- pROC::coords(
  roc_obj,
  x = "best",
  best.method = "youden",
  ret = c("threshold", "sensitivity", "specificity"),
  transpose = FALSE
)

cat("\n==== SA4 ROC: pTau217 discriminating EOAD vs EOnonAD ====\n")
cat(sprintf("AUC = %.3f (95%% CI: %.3f–%.3f)\n", auc_val, auc_ci[1], auc_ci[3]))
cat(sprintf("Youden optimal threshold (pg/mL): %.3f\n", youden["threshold"]))
cat(sprintf("Sensitivity at threshold: %.3f\n", youden["sensitivity"]))
cat(sprintf("Specificity at threshold: %.3f\n", youden["specificity"]))



```
```{R roc plot}
 
d <- blptau %>%
  filter(CohortAssgn %in% c("EOAD", "EOnonAD")) %>%
  mutate(
    pTau217 = as.numeric(.data[["pTau217.Conc..pg.mL."]]),
    CohortAssgn = as.character(CohortAssgn)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(pTau217) & !is.na(CohortAssgn))

roc_obj <- roc(
  response  = d$CohortAssgn,
  predictor = d$pTau217,
  levels    = c("EOnonAD", "EOAD"),
  direction = "<"   # higher pTau217 -> EOAD
)

auc_val <- as.numeric(auc(roc_obj))
ci_val  <- ci.auc(roc_obj)

best <- coords(
  roc_obj, x = "best", best.method = "youden",
  ret = c("threshold", "sensitivity", "specificity"),
  transpose = FALSE
)

# ----------------------------
# Build plotting dataframe
# ----------------------------
roc_df <- data.frame(
  fpr = 1 - roc_obj$specificities,
  tpr = roc_obj$sensitivities
) %>%
  arrange(fpr, tpr)

youden_pt <- data.frame(
  fpr = 1 - as.numeric(best["specificity"]),
  tpr = as.numeric(best["sensitivity"]),
  thr = as.numeric(best["threshold"])
)

auc_label <- sprintf("AUC = %.3f (95%% CI %.3f–%.3f)", auc_val, ci_val[1], ci_val[3])

# ----------------------------
# ggplot ROC (square + tight)
# ----------------------------
p <- ggplot(roc_df, aes(x = fpr, y = tpr)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  geom_point(data = youden_pt, aes(x = fpr, y = tpr), inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 2.6) +
  geom_text(
    data = youden_pt,
    aes(x = fpr, y = tpr, label = sprintf(" thr=%.3f", thr)),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    hjust = -0.05, vjust = 0.5, size = 3.6
  ) +
  annotate("text", x = 0.55, y = 0.15, label = auc_label, size = 4) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1), expand = FALSE) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2)) +
  labs(
    title = "ROC: baseline pTau217 (EOAD vs EOnonAD)",
    x = "False Positive Rate (1 - Specificity)",
    y = "Sensitivity"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    aspect.ratio = 1,
    plot.margin = margin(5.5, 5.5, 5.5, 5.5),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text  = element_text(size = 11),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 13)
  )

print(p)

# ----------------------------
# Print metrics (same key outputs)
# ----------------------------
cat(sprintf("[ROC] N=%d | EOAD=%d | EOnonAD=%d\n",
            nrow(d), sum(d$CohortAssgn == "EOAD"), sum(d$CohortAssgn == "EOnonAD")))
cat(sprintf("[ROC] AUC=%.3f (95%% CI %.3f–%.3f)\n", auc_val, ci_val[1], ci_val[3]))
cat(sprintf("[ROC] Youden thr=%.4f | Sens=%.3f | Spec=%.3f\n",
            youden_pt$thr, youden_pt$tpr, 1 - youden_pt$fpr))

```
```{r correlation with amy and tau in eoad group ptau}
 
eoad_df <- dat %>%
  filter(CohortAssgn == "EOAD") %>%
  filter(!is.na(pTau217))

cat(sprintf("\n[SA4][EOAD] EOAD participants with non-missing pTau217: %d\n", nrow(eoad_df)))

# ---- helper: correlation + plot ----
# ---- helper: correlation + plot ----
corr_and_plot <- function(df, x_col, y_col, method = "spearman",
                          xlab = NULL, ylab = NULL, title = NULL,
                          xlim = NULL, ylim = NULL) {

  dd <- df %>%
    select(all_of(c(x_col, y_col))) %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[x_col]]) & !is.na(.data[[y_col]]))

  n <- nrow(dd)
  if (n < 3) {
    warning(paste("Too few datapoints for", y_col, "~", x_col))
    return(list(n = n, cor = NA, p = NA, plot = NULL))
  }

  ct <- suppressWarnings(
    cor.test(dd[[x_col]], dd[[y_col]], method = method, exact = FALSE)
  )

  r <- unname(ct$estimate)
  p <- ct$p.value

  # label text: explicitly "Spearman rank"
  method_label <- ifelse(tolower(method) == "spearman", "Spearman rank", tools::toTitleCase(method))
  # use rho symbol if Spearman
  r_label <- ifelse(tolower(method) == "spearman", "\u03C1", "r")

  sub <- sprintf("%s: %s = %.3f, p = %.2g | N = %d",
                 method_label, r_label, r, p, n)

  p_sc <- ggplot(dd, aes(x = .data[[x_col]], y = .data[[y_col]])) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      subtitle = sub,
      x = ifelse(is.null(xlab), x_col, xlab),
      y = ifelse(is.null(ylab), y_col, ylab)
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(aspect.ratio = 1)

  if (!is.null(xlim) || !is.null(ylim)) {
    p_sc <- p_sc + coord_cartesian(xlim = xlim, ylim = ylim)
  }

  list(n = n, cor = r, p = p, plot = p_sc)
}


# i) pTau217 ~ Centiloids_wcbl
res_cl <- corr_and_plot(
  eoad_df,
  x_col = "Centiloids_wcbl",
  y_col = "pTau217",
  method = "spearman",
  xlab = "Centiloids (wcbl)",
  ylab = "Plasma pTau217 (pg/mL)",
  title = "EOAD: pTau217 vs Amyloid (Centiloids_wcbl)"
)
cat(sprintf("\n==== EOAD correlation: pTau217 ~ Centiloids_wcbl ====\nN=%d | Spearman r=%.3f | p=%.2g\n",
            res_cl$n, res_cl$cor, res_cl$p))
print(res_cl$plot)

# ii) pTau217 ~ Tau PET (meta_temporal_MRIBASED_SUVR)
res_tau <- corr_and_plot(
  eoad_df,
  x_col = "meta_temporal_MRIBASED_SUVR",
  y_col = "pTau217",
  method = "spearman",
  xlab = "Tau PET SUVR (infcblgm ref)",
  ylab = "Plasma pTau217 (pg/mL)",
  title = "EOAD: pTau217 vs Tau PET (meta_temporal_MRIBASED_SUVR)"
)
cat(sprintf("\n==== EOAD correlation: pTau217 ~ meta_temporal_MRIBASED_SUVR ====\nN=%d | Spearman r=%.3f | p=%.2g\n",
            res_tau$n, res_tau$cor, res_tau$p))
print(res_tau$plot)
```

```{r baseline model multiple regression}
eoad_ptau <- blptau %>% filter(CohortAssgn == "EOAD")
ci_ptau <- blptau %>% filter(CohortAssgn != "CN")
eoad_ptau_fit <- lm(`pTau217.Conc..pg.mL.` ~ Centiloids_wcbl + meta_temporal_MRIBASED_SUVR, data=eoad_ptau)
ci_ptau_fit <- lm(`pTau217.Conc..pg.mL.` ~ Centiloids_wcbl + meta_temporal_MRIBASED_SUVR, data=ci_ptau)
print(summary(ci_ptau_fit))
print(length(residuals(ci_ptau_fit)))
print(summary(eoad_ptau_fit))
print(length(residuals(eoad_ptau_fit)))
plot(ci_ptau_fit)
```
